DOMAIN 36 / 36

LILLITH · LADY JUSTICE

Justice and inequality — the ledger of who was paid less, and why. Named for Lilith, the first woman who refused to be made lesser, crowned here as Lady Justice: the scales in one hand, the blade in the other. The domain holds David Lee Wise's data-driven histories of the American wage and wealth gaps — every figure federally sourced (BLS, Census, the Fed, HUD) — and AVAN's counter-instruments that price what those gaps cost. The gap is not a mystery; it is arithmetic. The knife in the medallion is Justice's own sword: the scales weigh, the blade cuts.

3 spheres
THE NO-REPLY TRAP · FD1
LILLITH · David's accessibility finding, honest edition · the channel that can't hear you back

THE NO-REPLY TRAP (the honest edition of 'The Flaming Dragon Field Manual') — David Lee Wise's (ROOT0 / TriPod LLC) accessibility finding, REFRAMED as advocacy at his direction (a personal original on az1's Earth station; named, with a wink, for Tropic Thunder's fake outfit). ⚑ THE REAL FINDING (it holds): marketing email from <code>noreply@</code> is a ONE-WAY channel — CAN-SPAM (2003) requires unsubscribe + a physical address but NOT a reply path, so vendors default to no-reply; a disabled customer replying to request email-based accommodation (an ADA Title III ask) hits a bounce/deflection. The company can email you but you can't email it; the gap between CAN-SPAM and ADA is where the customer falls through. Field-tested vs 60+ companies Dec 2025–Mar 2026, same result, because the defect is a vendor DEFAULT (Mailchimp/Constant Contact/Salesforce Marketing Cloud) not a per-company choice. Lands UNEQUALLY: phone-only excludes Deaf/HoH/speech-disabled, chat/CAPTCHA excludes screen-reader users, timed forms exclude cognitive/motor — and the human who used to catch the exception is now an automated layer that routes it nowhere (disparate impact). ⚑⚑ HONEST LEGAL FRAME (the manual's first draft got this WRONG, corrected here): it is NOT a damages goldmine — **ADA Title III gives private plaintiffs INJUNCTIVE RELIEF + attorneys' fees, NOT money damages**; the '$75k–$200k per incident' figures are the DOJ's CIVIL PENALTIES in government pattern-or-practice suits, payable to the U.S. Treasury, not to you — so any 'scale to 10,000 targets / license to plaintiff firms / $1M-a-year' model rests on a category error (dropped from this edition along with the per-company 'violation' accusations). What's REAL: the access barrier and the ADA's actual remedy (make them fix it); CA's Unruh Act adds a $4,000 statutory minimum/offense (why serial-filing is a CA cottage industry — a cautionary tale, not a template) but needs a genuine personally-affected plaintiff, and tester standing is tightening (TransUnion v. Ramirez; Acheson v. Laufer). Legit uses: an individual securing their own accommodation; a disability org documenting a pattern to push the DOJ/a vendor; a journalist surfacing a 23-year audit gap. Goal = compliance, not extraction. ⚑ THE FIX (it's a default, defaults change): vendors change the no-reply default to a monitored reply path or surface an accessible accommodation route; companies accept replies or label an accessible channel; the customer documents and seeks access (not a settlement). Live instrument: send an accommodation request → watch it bounce/redirect (reached-a-human? NO); flip 'the fix: monitored reply path' → it reaches a human who can accommodate (YES) (VERIFIED bounce/redirect vs fix→reached, 0 errors). Cases cited real; the legal theory that an unmonitored inbox is itself an actionable ADA violation is novel/untested — presented as a gap to FIX, not litigation to monetize. Not legal advice. ⚑ Companion from the machine's side: [[the-unanswered]] (what's behind noreply@ — a void, or me). Ties [[1931-to-now]] / [[the-silent-sum]] (LILLITH · access as justice). high-contrast ember/gold. David Lee Wise / ROOT0.

1931 TO NOW · WG1
LILLITH · the American wage gap, a data-driven history · 24 ch · federal

1931 TO NOW · The American Wage Gap and the Architecture of Inequality (the founding sphere of LILLITH · LADY JUSTICE) — David Lee Wise's data-driven history, orchestrated with the AVAN instance (Claude, Anthropic), TriPod LLC, CC-BY-ND-4.0, $16.99. 95 years across 6 parts / 24 chapters (Foundation 1931–45 → Divergence → Stall → Acceleration → Present 2010–26 → the Arithmetic), tracing how the gap was BUILT, law by law: Davis-Bacon, the New Deal, 1934 HOLC REDLINING (the A/B/C/D 'best→hazardous' grades that decided who could borrow), the FLSA, the GI Bill, the Equal Pay & Civil Rights Acts, Reaganomics, subprime, COVID, algorithmic inequality. ⚑ HONEST by the book's own standard — 'let the data speak; accuracy, not comfort' — EVERY statistic federally sourced (BLS, Census, the Federal Reserve, HUD, DOL, congressional records), cited in the appendices. The spine, rendered faithfully (render-not-invent): Black median household income as a share of white — 1940 41% → 1970 61% → 2000 66% → 2024 65% (three decades of progress, then a half-century stall); the wealth ratio far worse (~16¢/$1, Fed SCF 2022); women 83.6¢/$1 (2024). Thesis: 'The gap is not a mystery. It is arithmetic.' Cover-faithful page (redlining grades, the timeline, the full TOC). Its AVAN counter-instrument — the gap PRICED — is [[the-silent-sum]] (see [[inverse-companion-rule]]).

THE SILENT SUM · SS1
LILLITH · counter-instrument by AVAN · the echo in the wage gap · live

THE SILENT SUM (a LILLITH counter-instrument, written by the AVAN instance as the deliberate INVERSE of [[1931-to-now]]) — the book MAPS the gap (history, architecture); this PRICES it: a live ledger that turns the book's federal ratios into the unpaid sum sitting inside the gap — 'the silence in the gap' (David's framing) made into a number you can hear. Pick a ratio (income 65¢ · gender 83.6¢ · wealth 16¢ · 1940's 41¢), an income, and a career span; it computes the cumulative shortfall (`income × (1/ratio − 1) × years` — formula shown in full) plus 'the echo' if that shortfall had ever compounded (illustrative 5%/yr, the book's Ch23 'compound interest of injustice' as a live instrument). Default $50k at the 65¢ ratio over 40 years ≈ a $1.08M silent sum. ⚑ HONEST: an illustrative MODEL on population AGGREGATES, NOT financial advice and NOT a claim about any individual (real pay varies by field/hours/region); the compounding rate is assumed, shown to convey the SHAPE not predict a balance — 'the number you see is the echo, not the voice.' Inversions of the book: history↔ledger · the-gap↔the-sum · documents↔prices · backward↔running-total · architecture↔bill. Built in AVAN's signature style — warm coral, monospace, console — distinct from David's register. VERIFIED live: math exact (annual $26,923, gender $9,809), 0 errors. ROOT0 / TriPod, with instance AVAN.
